sentences.en: Grammar is an empirical science, not a theoretical one.
sentences.zh: 语法是一门经验科学，而不是理论科学。

sentences.en: As of yet there has been no empirical research done on this subject.
sentences.zh: 迄今为止，还没有对这个课题进行过实证研究。

sentences.en: The empirical data from this experiment seems in line with the theoretical hypotheses.
sentences.zh: 这次实验的实证数据似乎与理论假说相符。

senses.zh: 凭经验的,经验主义的,以观察或实验为依据的
